search_placeholder: Search documents and press Enter… e.g. 'quarterly report'
no_dir_banner: No document directory configured yet. Click the Settings (gear) icon above and set a document directory to get started.
synopsis_generating: Still generating… the AI model may still be loading into memory. Hang tight.
synopsis_still_working: Still working… this can take a bit longer the first time after a restart.
synopsis_error_generate: Could not generate a synopsis for this document.
error_unreachable: Cannot reach the DocuBrowse service. Make sure it is running, then reload this page.
set_docdirs_desc: Top-level directories that are indexed. The first directory is the primary docPath; any others are additional scan directories. Add a directory below, or click the ✕ to the right of a directory to remove it.
set_ignored_desc: Directories listed here are skipped during scans. Adding a directory removes any documents already in the index from that location; if you remove a directory from this list later, run a rescan to bring its documents back.
set_excluded_desc: Click the ✕ to the right of a directory to remove it from the exclusion list, then rescan to bring its documents back.
set_status_defaults: Using built-in defaults — save to create a config file
set_confirm_rebuild: Switching languages changes the embedding model and search index — existing documents need to be re-embedded and the search index rebuilt for search quality to match the new language. This can take a while depending on your document count. Continue?
set_no_excluded: No directories excluded — all document directories are scanned
set_confirm_exclude:
Excluding "{path}" from scanning will also remove any documents already in the index from this directory.

Continue?
set_confirm_remove_exclude:
Remove "{path}" from the exclusion list?

A rescan will be needed afterward to bring its documents back into the index.
set_removed_exclude:
"{path}" has been removed from the exclusion list.

To bring documents from this directory back into the index, run a rescan.
set_no_docdirs: No document directories yet — add one to start indexing.
set_refresh_notice: Language updated. Refresh the page to see the interface in your selected language.
syn_err_empty: No description or text is available for this document to summarize.
syn_err_timeout: The AI model is still loading after a recent restart — this can take a minute the first time. Please wait a moment and try again.
syn_err_ollama: Couldn't reach the AI model (Ollama). Make sure it's running, then try again.
